import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document("unpacked")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for p in paras:
    style = ""
    ppr = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    if ppr:
        st = ppr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
        if st:
            style = st[0].getAttribute("w:val")
    texts = [t.firstChild.nodeValue for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t") if t.firstChild]
    text = "".join(texts)
    if style or text.strip():
        print(f"STYLE={style!r} TEXT={text!r}")

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document("unpacked")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
changed = []
for p in paras:
    texts = [t.firstChild.nodeValue for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t") if t.firstChild]
    text = "".join(texts)
    if not text or not any(c.isalpha() for c in text):
        continue
    if any(c.islower() for c in text):
        continue
    runs = p.getElementsByTagName("w:r")
    for r in runs:
        rpr = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if not rpr:
            rpr_el = editor.dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr_el, r.firstChild)
            rpr = [rpr_el]
        u = rpr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:u")
        if not u:
            u_el = editor.dom.createElement("w:u")
            u_el.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            rpr[0].appendChild(u_el)
    changed.append(text)
doc.save()
print("Underlined headlines:", changed)

import xml.dom.minidom as minidom

path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
dom = minidom.parse(path)
paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
changed = []
for p in paras:
    texts = [t.firstChild.nodeValue for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t") if t.firstChild]
    text = "".join(texts)
    if not text or not any(c.isalpha() for c in text):
        continue
    if any(c.islower() for c in text):
        continue
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if not rprs:
            rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        else:
            rpr = rprs[0]
        us = rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u")
        if not us:
            u = dom.createElement("w:u")
            u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(u)
    changed.append(text)

with open(path, "wb") as f:
    dom.writexml(f, encoding="ascii")

print("Underlined headlines:", changed)
